### 2026-10-09 – Finally done the PCB for my SwiChain macropad thing! I decided to add some LEDs on the back (WS2812) for underglow, because rgb = more fps xD. Also I added some art because I dunno if I wanna 3D print

**3h**

Finally done the PCB for my SwiChain macropad thing! I decided to add some LEDs on the back (WS2812) for underglow, because rgb = more fps xD. Also I added some art because I dunno if I wanna 3D print a case for it or just use a bare PCB and it'll just look cool if I won't make that case. Overall I'm surprised I did this in like 7 hours and am really happy with how it's looking! Tomorrow I'll do some configuring with ZMK firmware and I'll be done with everything :D
